title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.4 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 12.4 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to read private CI/CD job artifacts from other projects via GitLab Pages due to improper file path validation. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
